newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Sept 18.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Front-page editorial marks the 65th anniversary of Japan's invasion of Manchuria and calls on Tokyo to renounce past militarism.
Premier Li Peng says losses of state-owned firms are one of the most pressing problems facing the Chinese economy but that overall economic performance was quite good
A senior economic official says some state enterprises will be eliminated in market competition.
The president of the Agriculture Bank calls for greater financial reform in rural areas.
The Agriculture Development Bank will complete the establishment of new branches before May 1997.
